name: TRINITY Waterproof Self-Adhesive Aluminium Foil Butyl Rubber Leak Repair Tape (50mm x 5m)
shortDescription: Heavy-duty 1.0mm thick pure butyl rubber adhesive tape laminated with reflective embossed aluminium foil for instant permanent waterproofing of roof leaks and pipes.
overview: TRINITY Waterproof Butyl Repair Tape is an ultra-high performance self-adhesive flashing and leak barrier tape engineered for instant, permanent repairs on metal roofs, gutters, pipes, and tanks. Constructed from a thick, vulcanized 1.0mm layer of non-hardening pure butyl rubber adhesive laminated to an embossed heavy-gauge aluminium foil carrier, it forms an airtight and watertight bond that never dries out or cracks. It adheres aggressively to steel, aluminium, galvanised iron, glass, plastic, and concrete, withstanding temperatures from -40°C to +120°C.
keyFeatures: 100% Waterproof and airtight: instantly stops high-pressure leaks on contact
Thick 1.0mm pure butyl rubber adhesive conforms into cracks, seams, and rivet gaps
Heavy embossed aluminium foil backing reflects solar UV heat and resists puncture
Non-drying, permanently flexible elastomer moves with roof expansion and contraction
Operational temperature rating spanning from extreme sub-zero frost up to +120°C
Bonds tenaciously without primer to galvanized steel, asbestos, PVC, masonry, and glass
Peel-and-stick application: simply peel the release paper and press firmly

specifications.Water Pressure Resistance: Withstands hydrostatic head up to 3 Bar

applications: Sealing metal roofing sheet overlap joints, ridgelines, and screw penetrations
Repairing cracked PVC downpipes, rainwater gutters, and AC drain lines
Sealing shipping container roof puncture holes and truck canopy leaks
Waterproofing HVAC air duct flanges and underground utility conduit sleeves
